Inspection exposes canonical session history and final output; live tail supports pause/resume and auto-scroll with a bounded 200-event window. Explicit confirmation closes only the selected session through existing authenticated runtime intents, retaining immutable close requests for uncertain retries.
entries.validation: 32 backend tests passed (4 new runtime administration scenarios, 8 session-view regressions, 20 agent connection-status checks) and 5 frontend tests passed. Covered 12 turns in a shared session, last-10 ordering, operator authorization, cross-agent/host rejection, local/remote colliding session IDs, 52-instance pagination, unreleased failed sessions and closing one of two instances without affecting the other. Browser checks with intercepted mutations verified tail pause/resume, final-output inspection, cancellation and exactly one close; desktop/mobile layout checks passed. Production frontend/wheel build and installed dependency check passed. Actual installed UI and APIs successfully inspected existing Pi/Claude/Codex session history and results; no user messages were sent. Live installed modal subsequently listed all four real warm Pi instances and successfully paused/resumed their canonical event tail. Closure operation receipts are monitored so a later failure is surfaced instead of leaving a permanent Closing label.
